0f4a7c133caff32c99e7364c8de80ad8884b81df:
mutation FlxCrmGatheringSave($input: FlxGatheringSaveInput!) {
  flxGatheringSave(input: $input) {
    gathering {
      ...FlxCrmGatheringDetail
    }
    errors {
      ...FlxCrmUserError
    }
  }
}

fragment FlxCrmGatheringCard on FlxGathering {
  databaseId
  name
  status
  whenLabel
  place
  phaseTone
  phaseLabel
  peopleCount
  coverUrl
  dateDay
  dateMonth
  dateYear
  stats {
    label
    value
    hint
    progress
  }
  progress
  progressHint
  actions {
    label
    url
    target
    primary
  }
  mailReady
  postId
  pageState
  pageUrl
  pageTitle
  canCreatePage
}

fragment FlxCrmGatheringDetail on FlxGathering {
  ...FlxCrmGatheringCard
  summary
  note
  address
  mapUrl
  deliveredCount
  sendCount
  reasons {
    label
    count
    percent
  }
  recentSends {
    ...FlxCrmGatheringSend
  }
}

fragment FlxCrmGatheringSend on FlxGatheringSend {
  eventId

  tone

  text

  sendAt
  byName
  mediaId
  mediaUrl
  mediaIsImage
  thumbUrl
  channels {
    key
    label
    missing

    total

    }
    campaignId
  }
  eta {

  }

  replied
  optout
  failed

fragment FlxCrmUserError on FlxUserError {
  code

  field
}

fragment FlxCrmWhen on FlxDateTime {
  iso
  label
  relative
}
2d225670c8f751b66f91aa15ee1d5a9ec3c8efee:
query FlxCrmGatheringSendView($id: Int!, $key: String!, $channel: String, $status: String, $first: Int = 40, $after: String) {
  flxGatheringSend(id: $id, key: $key) {
    ...FlxCrmGatheringSend
    recipients(channel: $channel, status: $status, first: $first, after: $after) {
      totalCount
      channel
      channels
      countSent
      countWaiting
      countFailed
      countOther
      nodes {
        name
        recipient
        status
        error
        sentAt
        scheduledAt
        delivered
        read
        replied
        optout
        hasEngagement
      }
      pageInfo {
        hasNextPage
        endCursor
      }
    }
  }
}
